bio.text: Mallory Dittmer, of Fort Mill, is the Democratic nominee for South Carolina's 5th Congressional District, having defeated Andrew Clough for the nomination; she faces Republican Wes Climer in November.
WRHI's report on her campaign launch describes her as a former fashion industry professional turned small business owner.
Dittmer co-founded Community Advocates for Public Education York County, a nonpartisan group supporting public schools, and launched her campaign in October 2025.

sources.title: Mallory Dittmer Wins Democratic Nomination for Congress in South Carolina's 5th District
Mallory Dittmer Launches Campaign for South Carolina's 5th Congressional District
